hypothesis: Each service/comfort rating's relation to satisfaction depends on WHO is flying (context): encoding every rating column conditioned on the traveler context cell (Customer Type x Type of Travel x Class) adds fold-0 signal beyond the 21 raw covariates that neither the raw ordinal values nor the context cell alone carry.
why_distinct: FEAT58 encoded the demographic COMBO cell itself (one TE column for the 4-way key). FEAT49 instead encodes each RATING VALUE conditioned on context (13 separate columns: key = rating value x context cell), i.e. the interaction of service ratings with traveler segment -- a different feature hypothesis, not a rerun of 58. Distinct from all prior FEAT screens (learned similarity, factorization, leaf embeddings, local transforms, rare combos) which never conditioned a rating on a context cell.

method.base: 21 raw covariates (raw21), identical to FEAT54/58 harness
method.context_cell: Customer Type x Type of Travel x Class (<= 18 cells)
method.rating_columns: the 13 service/comfort ratings (wifi, dep/arr convenience, booking, gate, food, boarding, seat, entertainment, onboard, legroom, baggage, checkin, cleanliness)
method.encoding: adaptive (James-Stein) shrinkage target encoding, lam=40, one column per rating: key = (rating value, context cell)
method.strict_protocol: identical to FEAT58: EVAL (fold-0) encodings from outer-FIT statistics only; FIT encodings inner-cross-fit within outer-FIT (own inner fold excluded); ES labels excluded from every encoding source. Fold-safe TE.
method.estimator: LGBMClassifier identical hyperparameters control vs treatment (n_estimators=6000, ES 250, lr=0.02, leaves=127, extra_trees=True, min_child=40, colsample=0.8, subsample=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, seed=1) -- NOTE extra_trees=True is licensed here only because FEAT screens run the SAME config for control and treatment (paired), not as an ensemble member claim
method.screen: fold-0 control vs treatment; frozen rule vs portfolio ref

decision_rule.frozen_rule: PROMISING iff fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND candidate Spearman vs portfolio < 0.995
decision_rule.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(treatment, portfolio_ref)) - AUC(portfolio_ref) on primary fold-0 (all 139927 rows)
decision_rule.augmentation_delta: treatment - control AUC is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY and cannot decide
decision_rule.screen_not_promotion: passing means a full 5-fold OOF + admission gate is warranted; it does not enter the ensemble directly

anti_leakage: EVAL (fold-0) encodings computed from outer-FIT (minus ES) statistics only
FIT encodings inner-cross-fit: row's own inner fold excluded from its encoding source
ES (inner 10% of FIT) labels excluded from all encoding sources
no label used at EVAL time; encoding lookup is pure statistics of FIT
portfolio ref OOF loaded from the prediction store, hash-checked by store loader
